Hi:

My question is, the effect of the laibon being 2 more capacity for non-
orun cards played by another methuselahs is increased by every orun on
the minion, or is always 2?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Two additional capacity per each Orun. They stack.

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:

Another Orun question - if, say, a 4-cap diablerizes a 3-cap with an
Orun, does the 4-cap get to search for a discipline card? On the one
hand, diablerie is not a card played by another methuselah, but on the
other hand, the 4-cap vampire *is* a card played by another
methuselah, isn't it? So does the 4-cap treat the 3-cap as a 5-cap,
or does the diablerie action treat the 3-cap as a 3-cap?
